name: bananana brain
description: The bananana brain is your own control room for servers, Macs and PCs: live readings, alerts, automations, files, terminals and history on your own hardware, reached from anywhere at your-name.bananana.dev and in the bananana.dev iPhone and Android apps through an outbound end-to-end encrypted relay, with no open ports or VPN.

notes.text: Create a free account at https://bananana.dev/start, put the setup token in /opt/bananana-brain/.env and run: cd /opt/bananana-brain && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
The LAN dashboard on port 18771 uses a self-signed certificate. Data lives in /opt/bananana-brain/data; keep it backed up.
